source_caption:
Florence Pugh and Timothée Chalamet’s scenes in Little Women work so well because Amy and Laurie aren’t written as a simple consolation romance. Greta Gerwig reframes Amy as someone with ambition, clarity, and self-respect — and her confrontation with Laurie makes the relationship feel earned, not like a second choice.

Little Women (2019), directed by Greta Gerwig, starring Saoirse Ronan, Florence Pugh, Timothée Chalamet. A vibrant and emotionally rich adaptation that reimagines a literary classic with warmth and modern energy, celebrating ambition, sisterhood, love, and the quiet power of choosing your own path.
